title: createResource
subtitle: Create a lifecycle-aware entity resource
description: Factory for a Resource instance: draft editing, validation, persist, fetch/save, and subscriptions.

callouts.title: Destroy when done
callouts.content: Call `resource.destroy()` when the instance is no longer needed (tests, route teardown, HMR). React `useResource` does this on unmount.

signature.code: createResource<T, R = T>(config: ResourceConfig<T, R>): Resource<T, R>

rows.name: config.key
rows.description: Identity for persist/React recreate. String/number or tuple, e.g. ['product', id].

rows.name: config.persist
rows.description: Local draft/cache. Requires key when enabled.

rows.name: config.sourceUpdate
rows.description: How drafts behave when source refreshes.

returns.description: Subscribeable resource with draft APIs and snapshot

properties.name: snapshot
properties.description: Current data, draft, flags, errors, query/mutation

examples.title: Fetch + save + Zod
Field & array edits
Read snapshot

behavior.title: Draft = source + overrides
behavior.description: Edits never mutate source until save success (unless optimistic).

behavior.title: save() validates first
behavior.description: Failed validation skips source.save and returns a failure result.

behavior.title: Config enables features
behavior.description: No public plugins — validate, persist, optimistic activate from config only.

dos: Use a stable composite key for persist and multi-entity routes
Prefer zodResolver for large nested schemas
Subscribe at field grain for hot inputs
donts: Don't share one Resource across unrelated entities without key changes
Don't treat draft persist as an offline write queue
Don't forget destroy() outside React hooks
